chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not touch (with his hand) except the Black Corner and the Yemeni Corner. Then he would kiss them both and place his cheek upon them both. And I saw my father doing it.

key_terms.الرُّكْنُ الْأَسْوَدُ: The Black Corner (Stone) of the Kaaba
key_terms.الْيَمَانِيَّ: The Yemeni Corner of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic practice regarding touching and kissing the corners of the Kaaba during Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the specific Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to exclusively touch and kiss the Black Stone and the Yemeni Corner during Tawaf, distinguishing these acts from mere touching of other corners. It underscores the Shia emphasis on emulating the Prophet's precise ritual actions, where kissing serves as a sign of reverence and connection to the divine, while placing the cheek against the stone reflects deep love and humility. This practice is rooted in the Quranic command to 'turn towards the Sacred House' (2:158), linking physical gesture with spiritual orientation.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Giyas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not touch except for the corner of the Black (Stone), and the Yamani (corner). Then he<sup>saww</sup> kissed them both, and placed his<sup>saww</sup> cheek upon them both, and I<sup>asws</sup> saw my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> doing it’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,’ would not touch anything except the corner of the Black Stone and al-Yemaniy corner. He (the Messenger of Allah) kissed them and placed his cheek against them and I saw my father also did so.’”
